area.text: lamina Paper — Add and edit content

a01.text:
A01 · Edit mode: add text box

Purpose: add new text anywhere on a page, styled from the inspector.

States: Add text tool armed, box being typed (shown; still "No unsaved changes" until typing ends), box selected, empty box removed on Escape, signed-file gate.

Todos: E6c, E6e

a02.text:
A02 · Place image and shapes

Purpose: place images, logos and shapes as page content (not annotations), then move, resize, rotate, crop and fade them.

States: placed logo selected with a snap guide and the Image inspector (left), rectangle selected with the Rectangle inspector (right), unsupported file, very large image, picker cancelled.

Todos: E6b

a03.text:
A03 · Watermark, header and footer

Purpose: stamp a watermark or background, headers and footers with page tokens, or Bates numbers on a page range, with a live preview.

States: Watermark tab (left), Header & footer tab with an overlap warning (right), invalid range, editing an existing mark.

Todos: E6d

a04.text:
A04 · Edit existing text inline

Purpose: edit a detected text run in place, keeping the embedded font when it has the glyphs and saying so when it doesn't.

States: editing with a substituted character (left), text that can't be edited in place with its reason and alternatives (right), reverted.

Todos: E7e, E7f

a05.text:
A05 · Select and transform existing objects

Purpose: select images, vector paths and text blocks already in the file; move, resize, rotate, restyle, reorder, clip, unmask or delete them.

States: vector group selected with the context menu (left), paragraph selected as a text block (middle), edit points of one bar (right), shared image, locked or unsupported object.

Todos: E7d, E7h

a06.text:
A06 · Search and replace

Purpose: replace text across the whole document with a preview, per-match skip and a report of what could not be replaced.

States: matches listed with one skipped (left), replace-all report with one failure and undo (right), no matches.

Todos: E7g

a07.text:
A07 · Structure and conformance warning

Purpose: keep tags valid while editing and tell the user, before saving, when an edit breaks a PDF/A or PDF/UA claim.

States: info banner on entering Edit, warning banner with the issue in the inspector (left), save check dialog (right), all checks pass.

Todos: E7i
